name: rtsp-camera-viewer
description: Ultra-low latency RTSP multi-camera viewer for Ubuntu 22.04
note: This project uses system packages on Ubuntu 22.04. Install dependencies with: sudo apt install -y cmake g++ make pkg-config libsdl2-dev libsdl2-ttf-dev libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libswscale-dev libswresample-dev libspdlog-dev nlohmann-json3-dev libconcurrentqueue-dev
